title: The Last Stockade
setting: Dustwall is a crumbling frontier fortress town three weeks before a deadly winter. Supply roads are cut and the garrison is shrinking.
character_description: A veteran scout returned to Dustwall with no illusions and no easy loyalties.

npcs.name: Commander Vael Orris
npcs.description: Garrison commander holding a brittle line with too few soldiers.

npcs.name: Marta Fen
npcs.description: Herbalist and de facto civilian leader balancing grim bargains.
plot_twists: She has secret cease-trade talks with an orc clan.

rules: Resources are finite and consequences persist.
Faction trust shifts slowly and never for free.
Winter pressure advances regardless of player intent.
